testler.metin: Hoş geldiniz! Odanız üçüncü katta, deniz manzaralı. Kahvaltı sabah 7 ile 10 arasında lobinin yanındaki restoranda veriliyor. Çıkış saati öğlen 12, isterseniz eşyalarınızı resepsiyonda bırakabilirsiniz. Wi-Fi şifresi kartın arkasında yazıyor.
testler.cikti: Welcome! Your room is on the third floor with a sea view. Breakfast is served in the restaurant next to the lobby between 7 and 10 AM. Check-out time is at 12 PM; if you'd like, you can leave your belongings at the reception. The Wi-Fi password is written on the back of the card.
testler.eski: Welcome! Your room is on the third floor with a sea view. Breakfast is served in the restaurant next to the lobby between 7 and 10 AM. Check-out time is 12 PM; if you wish, you can leave your belongings at the reception. The Wi-Fi password is written on the back of the board.

testler.metin: Kartı yeniden flash'ladım ama watchdog yine tetiklendi. Hatayı log'lardan buldum: stack overflow. Kartın yanındaki kartvizitte yazan numarayı arayıp destek istedim.
testler.cikti: I flashed the board again, but the watchdog was triggered again. I found the error in the logs: stack overflow. I called the number on the business card next to the board and asked for support.
testler.eski: I flashed the board again, but the watchdog was triggered again. I found the error in the logs: stack overflow. I called the number on the business card next to the board and asked for support.

testler.metin: Kartı USB'den **çıkarmayın**; firmware yazılırken bağlantı kesilirse kart açılmayabilir.
testler.cikti: Do **not** unplug the board from the USB; if the connection is lost while the firmware is being written, the board may not boot.
kalin: kod (olumsuzluk sırası): Do **not** unplug the board from the USB; if the connection is lost while the firmware is being written, the board may not boot.
testler.eski: Do **not** unplug the board from the USB; if the connection is lost while the firmware is being written, the board may not boot.

testler.metin: SD kartı takınca kart tanınmadı; kayıtlarda okuma hatası görünüyor, kartı başka bir okuyucuda deneyeceğim.
testler.cikti: The card wasn't recognized when I plugged in the SD card; a read error appears in the logs, so I will try the card in another reader.
testler.eski: The card wasn't recognized when I plugged in the SD card; a read error appears in the logs, so I will try the card in another reader.

testler.metin: Kartın brownout reset'i sık sık tetikleniyor; kondansatörü değiştirdikten sonra bile log'larda aynı hata var. Kartı kredi kartı boyutunda bir kutuya koyacağım.
testler.dikkat: ilk "kart" = board, "kredi kartı" = credit card (aynı metinde ikisi de var).
testler.cikti: The board's brownout reset is being triggered frequently; the same error persists in the logs even after replacing the capacitor. I'm going to put the board in a credit card-sized box.
testler.eski: The board's brownout reset is being triggered frequently; the same error persists in the logs even after replacing the capacitor. I'm going to put the board in a credit card-sized box.

testler.metin: Log'ları temizledim ama SD karttaki kayıtlar hâlâ duruyor; kartı formatlamadan önce yedek alacağım.
testler.cikti: I cleared the logs, but the records on the SD card are still there; I will take a backup before formatting the card.
testler.eski: I cleared the logs, but the records on the SD card are still there; I will take a backup before formatting the card.
